Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Thanks for the last set of my books, and for the Kingsley’s whereof we have been going through a course.[^1]
If I might have the payment for the first edition of [Beechcroft at Rockstone](/book/201) I should be glad.
I suppose the [last volume of Cameos](/book/213) is waiting for its index, but I hope it will be out before the season is over.[^2]
[The Reputed Changeling](/book/205)is a much better thing I hope than the Rockstone story, which is really only a continuation for the sake of old friends
I suppose it will soon be ready. Please let these copies be sent, and the sheets to [Tauchnitz](/person/2124).
I hear that [the Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](/book/62) is much used as a class book in Switzerland

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Macmillan published a new edition of the complete works of [Charles Kingsley](/person/816) in 1889.
[^2]: Annotated \'yes\'.
